app.name: Recipe Gen
app.tagline: Cheap, fast meals from the supermarket.

generate.title: Make a recipe
generate.promptPlaceholder: e.g. cheap quick dinner, chicken breast in 15 min…
generate.fridgeNone: None selected — let the AI choose
generate.failed: Couldn't create a recipe. Please try again.
generate.crashed: The page reloaded last time because the phone ran out of memory. Switched to the low-memory Light model — please try again. Closing other apps and Safari tabs also helps.

model.title: Set up the AI model
model.desc: Recipes are generated entirely on this device. The model downloads once, then works offline.
model.wifi: This is a large download, so Wi-Fi is recommended.
model.noWebGPU: This device or browser doesn't support WebGPU
model.noWebGPUDesc: On iPhone or iPad, use Safari on iOS 26 or later. On a computer, use a recent Chrome or Edge.

detail.costNote: Prices are typical Japanese supermarket estimates (pantry staples excluded).

settings.title: Settings
settings.modelHint: Standard gives better recipes. Light suits older devices or low storage.
settings.notPersisted: The browser may clear data when space runs low
settings.backupDesc: Export your saved recipes to a JSON file, or import one.
settings.aboutText: Recipe Gen suggests cheap, quick recipes using only ingredients commonly found in Japanese supermarkets. The AI runs on your device, so what you type is never sent to a server. Prices are estimates.
a2hsSteps: Tap the Share button (□↑) at the bottom
